entities.name: RBC Insurance
entities.description: Brand: 'Companies operating under the RBC Insurance brand are:' (legal page). Overview page: 'RBC Insurance is the brand name for the insurance operating entities of Royal Bank of Canada'.

entities.name: RBC Life Insurance Company
entities.description: Underwriters page: 'Individual and Group Life and Health insurance is underwritten by RBC Life Insurance Company'; 'sole issuer and guarantor' of RBC Guaranteed Investment Funds (segregated funds); underwrites the Business Loan Insurance Plan; distributes Allstate group critical illness.

entities.name: RBC Insurance Company of Canada
entities.description: Underwriters page: 'Travel Insurance is underwritten by RBC Insurance Company of Canada.'

entities.name: RBC Insurance Agency Ltd
entities.description: Overview/underwriters pages: home and auto (P&C) offerings 'are distributed by RBC Insurance Agency Ltd. and underwritten by Aviva General Insurance Company'; 'acts as an independent agent selling and servicing these products'.

entities.name: RBC Insurance Services Inc.
entities.description: Overview page: 'provides administrative support services for the creditor insurance products offered to RBC Royal Bank personal and business clients' (life, disability and critical illness insurance for mortgages, loans and credit card balances).

entities.name: Assured Assistance Inc.
entities.description: Listed on the legal page without a description (travel-assistance company; no description on rbcinsurance.com pages checked).

ga_manager_statement.text: The participating account is 'collectively invested by the RBC Insurance investment team' which 'manages over $15 billion in assets' and 'follows the same investment philosophy as RBC Capital Markets and RBC Global Asset Management' (participating-account guide, Oct 2025). The legal page itself says nothing about who manages the general account; the Underwriters page only says the underlying funds of RBC Guaranteed Investment Funds 'are managed by RBC Global Asset Management Inc.' (segregated funds, not the general account).

operating_entities.note: Legal page lists the five entities as a flat list under the brand; it gives no parent/child detail and no descriptions, so descriptions are taken from two other rbcinsurance.com pages (/en-ca/underwriters/ and /en-ca/about/overview/). The 2019 'RBC Insurance at a Glance' PDF (rbcinsurance.com/pdf/rbci-at-a-glance-e.pdf) also named Royal Bank of Canada Insurance Company Ltd. (the reinsurance entity) as an RBC Insurance operating entity; the current legal page omits it, so it is not listed. RBC Capital Markets and RBC GAM are deliberately excluded (not RBC Insurance entities).
